'''Kalvin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] who was affiliated with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was skilled at dodging, conning others, [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]], swimming, [[Droid/Legends|droid]] programming and repair, and use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and technology. Standing 1.3 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, Kalvin wore shoes, pants, a [[Belt/Legends|belt]], a [[shirt]] and [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]], and a hat. He also carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], [[Syntherope/Legends|syntherope]], a tool kit, a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], and pouches.<ref name="RCAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalvin was created for the [[Rebel Characters Adventure Set|''Rebel Characters'' Adventure Set]], a boxed set of metal miniatures released in [[1989]] by [[West End Games]] to be used with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. Kalvin's character type was listed as "Kid" and his model came unpainted.<ref name="RCAS" />
